identitySignals: Name matches 'Occupational Therapy Training Program (OTTP)', a division of Special Service for Groups (SSG), per ssg.org and ottp.org
Agenda location Los Angeles, CA matches SSG's headquarters in Los Angeles and OTTP's Los Angeles County origin
OTTP's Northern California division (ottpnc.org) states it works with Oakland Unified School District and has an Oakland office, matching an OUSD Early Childhood services agreement
research.notes: The agenda names only the division 'Occupational Therapy Training Program' (Los Angeles, CA). The parent legal entity is Special Service for Groups, which has two OTTP divisions: OTTP (Los Angeles County, Gardena) and OTTP-NorCal/OTTP-SF (San Francisco, Oakland, Sacramento; its site says it works with OUSD). The contract is likely with SSG, but which division serves OUSD is not confirmed, so contact details are for SSG headquarters, not a division. Reviewer should confirm the division.

profile.summary: Special Service for Groups is a nonprofit health and human service organization based in Los Angeles. It runs community-based programs for vulnerable communities. Its Occupational Therapy Training Program is a division that provides occupational therapy and mental health services to children, youth, families and adults.
